Verdict_note: Jury found plaintiff had injuries but found defendant did not engage in reckless conduct; verdict for defendant on Special Verdict Form A
claude_notes: Two special verdict forms were provided (A and B); only Form A was completed by the jury. Form A found plaintiff had injuries (Yes) but defendant did not engage in reckless conduct (No), resulting in a defense verdict. Form B was left blank. The plaintiff Kimberly Squires was represented by her guardian and natural parent Lyle K. Squires; only Kimberly is counted as plaintiff.
